title: Constrain Console Insights: Prioritization of atomic tiles, fallback behaviors, and cost delta cards
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Purpose: Narrow the initial Redwood Console Insights MVP surface to a small set of deterministic, high-value tiles and defined fallback behaviors so we can ship a reliable, low-cost first release. This ticket is the product-level decision record that captures the features we are cutting, the minimal replacements, and the operational behavior for graceful degradation. Rationale: previous scopes attempted to cover broad telemetry (per-route heatmaps, full-trace waterfall visualizers, diffable cost reports) which expanded implementation effort and SLO risk. We need a tightly constrained set of deliverables for the MVP that meet core user needs: quick triage of latency regressions, visibility into per-route cost trends, and an on-call friendly fallback when tracing or cost joins fail. Scope changes: 1) Include only three atomic tiles in MVP: a) Route latency percentile tile (P50/P95 over time) b) Cost delta tile (7d vs 30d normalized change with guardrails) c) Error spike tile (count + top 3 impacted routes). 2) Defer full trace waterfall viewer and replace with a lightweight sampled-stack link that opens a separate Trace UI for dedicated customers (deferred to Dedicated+Private roadmap). 3) Replace per-token cost breakdown by model variant with an aggregated per-route cost trend and a 'significant delta' flag; full token-level drilldown is postponed. 4) Implement explicit fallback UX when tracing backend is unavailable: show cached last-known snapshot, surface a short explanation, and provide a single-click retry. 5) Limit retention for the MVP telemetry index to 14 days to reduce infra and cost concerns; longer retention is a follow-up. Operational considerations: - Define SLOs for tile render latency (95th < 1.5s) and graceful degradation window (<30s to detect telemetry backend outage). - Batching and sampling thresholds to be coordinated with ENG tracing infra owners (see dependencies). Acceptance criteria below capture the measurable bar for shipping.
acceptance_criteria: Three atomic tiles implemented in console UI: route-latency, cost-delta, error-spike; each with configuration toggles in the console admin panel
Tile render latency meets SLO: 95th percentile < 1.5s under staging load (defined in PERF-TRACE-01 harness)
When tracing backend returns 5xx or times out, console displays cached snapshot with timestamp and a human-readable fallback message + retry action
Cost delta tile shows normalized % delta and flags deltas > 20% with a link to a lightweight cost breakdown pane (no token-level breakdown required)
Telemetry retention for MVP is enforced at 14 days and documented in the ops runbook
E2E acceptance tests (Cypress) for tile rendering, fallback, and cost delta thresholds included in release branch
Product docs/README and runbook updated with MVP limitations, expected follow-up work, and known tradeoffs
